name: Tabris's Step
body:
Tabris's Step (Sp)
Source Disciple's Doctrine pg. 9
As a swift action, a magus can spend 1 point from his arcane pool and gain the effects of a water walk spell for 10 minutes per magus level. If he expends 2 points from his arcane pool, he can affect a total number of touched creatures equal to his magus level. The magus must be at least 6th level to select this arcana.
